name: MBTA Rail Guide
description: Answers questions about the MBTA's subway, light rail and commuter rail from its GTFS feed as a graph: stations, the stops in them, routes and the lines they are on.

tools.name: Which Routes Serve a Station
tools.description: Lists the routes and lines that serve one station, such as Park Street or South Station. Takes a station, not a route.

config.template: MATCH (line:Line)<-[:ON]-(service:Route)-[:SERVES]->(station:Station) WHERE station.name = $stationName WITH service, line ORDER BY service.order RETURN service.name AS route, line.name AS line, service.kind AS kind LIMIT $limit

parameters.name: stationName
parameters.description: The station's name as written in the question.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of rows to return.

tools.name: Stations on a Route in Order
tools.description: Lists every station one route serves, in the order a train reaches them, such as the Red Line or the Fitchburg Line. Takes a route, not a station.

config.template: MATCH (route:Route)-[serves:SERVES]->(station:Station) WHERE route.name = $routeName RETURN serves.sequence + 1 AS position, station.name AS station, station.municipality AS municipality ORDER BY position LIMIT $limit

parameters.name: routeName
parameters.description: The route's name as written in the question.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of rows to return.

tools.name: Subway Journey Between Two Stations
tools.description: Finds the journey with the fewest stops from one station to another by subway and light rail, step by step, with the line ridden on each step, so a change of line shows as the line changing. Takes two stations. Commuter rail is left out, so a station only it serves gives no rows.

config.template: MATCH (origin:Station), (destination:Station) WHERE origin.name = $fromStation AND destination.name = $toStation MATCH journey = shortestPath((origin)-[:CONNECTS*..80]->(destination)) WHERE all(leg IN relationships(journey) WHERE leg.kind <> 'commuter rail') UNWIND range(0, length(journey) - 1) AS step RETURN step + 1 AS step, nodes(journey)[step].name AS fromStation, nodes(journey)[step + 1].name AS toStation, relationships(journey)[step].line AS line LIMIT $limit

parameters.name: fromStation
parameters.description: The station the journey starts at.

parameters.name: toStation
parameters.description: The station the journey ends at.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of steps to return.

tools.name: Stations Near a Station
tools.description: Lists the stations within walking distance of one station, nearest first, with the distance in metres. Takes one station.

config.template: MATCH (centre:Station) WHERE centre.name = $nearStation MATCH (other:Station) WHERE other <> centre AND point.distance(centre.location, other.location) <= $withinMetres RETURN other.name AS station, toInteger(point.distance(centre.location, other.location)) AS metres ORDER BY metres LIMIT $limit

parameters.name: withinMetres
parameters.description: The distance in metres, only if the question gives one.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of rows to return.

tools.name: Platforms in a Station
tools.description: Lists the stops inside one station: each platform, the route that calls at it and whether it is wheelchair accessible. Takes one station.

config.template: MATCH (station:Station)<-[:IN]-(platform:Stop)<-[:CALLS_AT]-(route:Route) WHERE station.name = $platformsOf RETURN DISTINCT platform.platform AS platform, route.name AS route, platform.accessible AS accessible, platform.id AS stopId ORDER BY route, platform LIMIT $limit

parameters.name: platformsOf
parameters.description: The station's name as written in the question.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of rows to return.

tools.name: Stations in a Municipality
tools.description: Lists the stations in one city or town, such as Cambridge or Somerville, with the routes serving each. Takes a municipality.

config.template: MATCH (station:Station)<-[:SERVES]-(route:Route) WHERE station.municipality = $municipalityName RETURN station.name AS station, collect(DISTINCT route.name) AS routes ORDER BY station LIMIT $limit

parameters.name: municipalityName
parameters.description: The city or town as written in the question.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of rows to return.
